about: Formulas over many channels: vector tokens, severity() and connected(); and label(), the enum string of a channel's value. One table for every evaluator of the formula language. A channel is {value, severity 0-3, labels: its enum strings when it has them}; with "down" its connection is lost (a value given is stale and must not be read); a channel not listed has no sample. "nonFinite" is a number that JSON cannot hold: nan, inf or -inf. A channel listed with value null has an empty sample: it is there, without a number. The detail of input_missing says "PVs not available" for inputs with no sample or a lost connection, else "PVs without a number". Expect a value with the result's severity and vectorInputs (null: no such key), or an error class: input_missing, type_error, parse_error, invalid_spec. missingListed sets the cap on listed members (default 20), maxVectorInputs the most members the vector tokens may name (default 1000). A value may be an array: a sample that is not one number.
